title: Enhance authentication visibility, add book preferences, sample catalog, sell feature, menu system, and search capabilities

requirements.text: Increase the visual prominence of the login/signup button by making its background color deeper and more contrasting against the Pistachio Mist theme to ensure it is clearly visible in the navigation

quotes: I can't see any visible options for logging or sign up please make that make the given colour more deeper it daily visible now

acceptanceCriteria: Login/signup button has a deeper, more saturated background color
Button remains visible and clearly distinguishable from the Pistachio Mist background
Button maintains botanical theme consistency

requirements.text: Create a book preferences section positioned below the search bar where users can select their preferred book genres through a multi-select or filter interface

quotes: below the search bar make a section where people can fill out there books preference according to genre

acceptanceCriteria: Section appears directly below the search bar component
Users can select multiple genres from available options
Genre preferences are stored in user profile
UI follows botanical theme design

requirements.text: Display 5-6 sample books on the front page with placeholder images (labeled 'Image to be uploaded' or showing blank placeholders) and prices ranging from ₹100 to ₹200

quotes: give some books yesterday for the image of the book keeping blank or or say image to be uploaded keep the pricing of the book s for around rs 100 to 200 for the basic page must be at least 5 to 6 book for the front

acceptanceCriteria: 5-6 books are visible on the homepage
Book cards show placeholder images with 'Image to be uploaded' text or blank placeholder graphics
All sample books have prices between ₹100 and ₹200
Books display in the existing BookCatalog grid layout

requirements.text: Add a 'Sell Your Book' feature accessible from the homepage where customers can submit details about books they want to sell to Kitabi Keeda for resale

quotes: somewhere in the web page and option that face send your book where my customers will tell books to us that we sell further

acceptanceCriteria: Visible 'Sell Your Book' button or section on the homepage
Form or modal allows customers to submit book details (title, author, condition, etc.)
Submissions are stored in the backend
Confirmation message shown after successful submission

requirements.text: Create a menu section in the top-left corner of the navigation with dropdown or sidebar options including Settings, Personalization, and other utility menu items

quotes: at the top left corner give a section for different kind of menus like setting personalization and etc

acceptanceCriteria: Menu icon or button appears in the top-left corner of the navigation
Menu opens to reveal Settings and Personalization options
Menu items are clickable and navigate to respective sections
Menu design follows botanical theme

requirements.text: Add a camera/lens icon button that allows customers to upload or capture images of books they want to search for or sell, enabling image-based book identification

quotes: give a image of camera or lens through which can our customers can save their books via images also

acceptanceCriteria: Camera/lens icon is visible in the search or upload area
Clicking the icon opens camera access or file upload dialog
Users can capture or upload book images
Uploaded images are processed and associated with search or sell actions

requirements.text: Implement voice search functionality with a microphone icon that allows users to search for books using voice input

quotes: also give a mic  through which they can search by voice

acceptanceCriteria: Microphone icon appears in or near the search bar
Clicking the icon activates voice input
Voice input is converted to text and populates the search field
Search executes automatically or on user confirmation

requirements.text: Update the business address throughout the website to reflect Kolkata, India as the location, particularly in the footer and contact sections

quotes: for address detail use address in Kolkata India

acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays Kolkata, India as the business address
Contact section (if present) shows Kolkata, India location
Address format is clear and properly formatted

constraints: Use Internet Identity for authentication, not third-party providers
Maintain the existing single-actor Motoko backend architecture
Keep all frontend components using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI
Do not modify immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Preserve the Pistachio Mist color scheme and botanical leafy design theme
Use ₹ (Indian Rupees) for all pricing display
nonGoals: Integration with external voice recognition APIs (use browser Web Speech API)
Advanced image recognition or AI-based book identification
Third-party payment gateway integration beyond basic pricing display

required: Camera or lens icon for book image upload feature (camera-icon.dim_64x64.png)
Microphone icon for voice search functionality (microphone-icon.dim_64x64.png)
Menu hamburger icon with botanical styling for top-left navigation (menu-icon.dim_48x48.png)
Placeholder book cover image with 'Image to be uploaded' text (book-placeholder.dim_300x400.png)
